units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:4">Kel. II, 4</cite> <he>פ׳ שיש בו וכ׳</he> a lantern which contains a receptacle for oil; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 7:11">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. VII, 11</cite> <he>פ׳ של זכוכית וכ׳</he> a glass lantern &c. (v. <cite ref="Q00319"><he>פוקטו</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 6:7">Tosef. Ber. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 5:7">V</cite>), 7 <cite ref="Q00016"><he>פָאנָס</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="Q01206"><he>פנס</he></cite>); <cite ref="Berakhot 53b">Ber. 53ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. VIII, 12ᵇ bot.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:7">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>היה נוטל הפ׳ וכ׳</he> he (the Lord) took the torch and carried light before them (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 13:21">Ex. XIII, 21</cite>).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 25:6">Ex. R. s. 25</cite> <he>בשר ודם תלמוד טוען פ׳ וכ׳</he> among human beings, the pupil carries the light before his teacher; not so the Lord &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּנָסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">Gen. R. s. 3</cite>, beg. <he>הדליק נרות ופ׳</he> lighted lamps and torches.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">Ib.</cite> s. 68 <he>כבו את הנרות כבו הפ׳</he> put out the lamps, put out the torches.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:7">Koh. R. to XII, 7</cite> <he>הדליק נרות ופ׳ לשמה וכ׳</he> he lighted lamps and torches in the name of Rome (as an augury for a war against Rome), and they would not burn; a. e.
